jobPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the job posting here…
englishOnly: This tool reads job posts and CVs written in English, and it writes the headlines in English.
statusMatching: Matching your resume to the posting
statusNeedInput: Add the job description and your CV to generate.
statusPrivate: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
resultHeading: {count, plural, one {# headline} other {# headlines}} for <hl>{title}</hl>
titleFromPosting: The title comes from the posting. Every skill below appears in both your resume and the posting, so nothing here claims something your CV never mentions.
titleFromResume: We could not find a job title in the posting, so this uses the title in your resume. Every skill below appears in both documents.
titleGuess: The title is a best guess from the wording. Edit it if it is wrong.
claims: Claims {list}. Keep only what your CV can evidence.
toastCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the headline and copy it yourself.

titleSkills.hint: The LinkedIn and ATS staple. Reads well in a search result.

seniorityDomain.hint: Says what you do and where you have done it.

years.hintStated: Uses the number of years stated in your resume.
years.hintSpan: Uses the span between the earliest and latest dates in your resume. Change it if the number is wrong.

twoStrengths.hint: We could not find your years of experience. Add the number here yourself if you want it in the headline.

focus.hint: Leads with the work rather than the job title.

plain.hint: No pipes, so it sits cleanly under your name at the top of a CV.

noTitleHeading: We could not find a job title
noTitleBody: Neither document names a role we recognise, so a headline would be a guess. Paste the full posting, including the title at the top, or add your current job title to your CV, then generate again.
noOverlap: Your resume and this posting share almost no vocabulary. That is worth fixing before the headline. Start with the <link>ATS resume checker</link>.
missingHeading: In the posting, not in your CV
missingBody: None of these can go in a headline yet. Add the ones you can honestly evidence to a bullet first, then generate again. The <link>ATS resume checker</link> scores the whole CV the same way.
ctaTitle: Want the rest of the CV to match?
ctaBody: Paste the job link and FitMyCV rewrites your CV and cover letter against the posting, keeping your real experience.
examplesBody: Your five will be built from the posting you paste and the skills your CV already proves. Here is the shape they take.
